Confirmed: baseline had 5 failures (including the NullLibrary3 jakarta test); with the fix, NullLibrary3 passes and only the 4 pre-existing, unrelated record-component delombok failures remain.

Summary of the fix:

- `src/core/lombok/core/configuration/NullAnnotationLibrary.java:64` — added a `JAKARTA` library (`jakarta.annotation.Nonnull` / `jakarta.annotation.Nullable`), so `lombok.addNullAnnotations = jakarta` now works for generated code (equals/canEqual/toString/constructor/with-er, etc.).
- `src/core/lombok/core/handlers/HandlerUtil.java:194,252` — added `jakarta.annotation.Nonnull` to `NONNULL_ANNOTATIONS` (enables null-check generation) and both `jakarta.annotation.Nonnull`/`jakarta.annotation.Nullable` to `BASE_COPYABLE_ANNOTATIONS`, so lombok copies these annotations from fields to generated builder methods/setters/with-ers — which fixes the `@Builder` `first(@Nullable ...)` case from the issue. Also removed a duplicated `javax.annotation.Nonnull` entry.
- `src/core/lombok/ConfigurationKeys.java` — documented the new `jakarta` flavor.
